text: The Mount Batur sunrise trek was phenomenal! Our guide was incredibly patient and supportive. The breakfast cooked over volcanic steam was the perfect touch. Highly recommended!
name: Michelle

text: My husband and I booked the cycling tour for our anniversary. Cycling through the lush rice terraces and local villages gave us a completely different perspective of Bali.
name: Rina & Budi

text: We did the Ayung River rafting as a group of friends and it was hilarious and thrilling! Safety was clearly a priority, but they didn't forget to make it super fun.
name: The Adventure Squad
